questions.question: A newsvendor has integer demand $D$ with CDF $F(y)=\mathbb{P}(D\le y)$, unit cost $c$, salvage value $s<c$, price $p>c$, $b=p-c$, $h=c-s$ and $\beta(p)=\frac{p-c}{p-s}$. A whole-number order $y$ is optimal exactly when $F(y-1)\le\beta(p)\le F(y)$. The price equals the upper endpoint of the interval for $y$, so $\beta(p)=F(y)$. Which statement holds?
options: $y$ ties with the larger order $y+1$ in cost
$y$ is no longer optimal at this price
$y$ is the only optimal order at this price

questions.question: In the newsvendor model with selling price $p$, unit cost $c$ and salvage value $s$, the underage cost is $b=p-c$ and the overage cost $h=c-s$. When $p$ is raised with $c$ and $s$ fixed, what happens to $b$ and $h$?
options: $b$ and $h$ both rise by the same amount
$b$ rises and $h$ falls by the same amount

questions.question: A newsvendor has integer demand $D$ with CDF $F(y)=\mathbb{P}(D\le y)$, unit cost $c$, salvage value $s<c$, price $p>c$, $b=p-c$, $h=c-s$ and $\beta(p)=\frac{p-c}{p-s}$. A whole-number order $y$ is optimal exactly when $F(y-1)\le\beta(p)\le F(y)$. With $c=24$, $s=4$ and $F(y-1)=0.8$, what is the lowest price $p$ at which $y$ is still optimal?

Integer demand has $F(3)=0.15$, $F(4)=0.35$, $F(5)=0.62$, $F(6)=0.85$, $F(7)=1$ ($F(2)=0$). Unit cost is $c=8$, salvage $s=2$ and price $p=20$; the smallest optimal order is the first $y$ with $F(y)\ge\frac{p-c}{p-s}$. Which order is it?

A newsvendor has integer demand $D$ with CDF $F(y)=\mathbb{P}(D\le y)$, unit cost $c$, salvage value $s<c$, price $p>c$, $b=p-c$, $h=c-s$ and $\beta(p)=\frac{p-c}{p-s}$. A whole-number order $y$ is optimal exactly when $F(y-1)\le\beta(p)\le F(y)$. At the lower endpoint for $y$, $\beta(p)=F(y-1)$. How does $y$ compare with the smallest optimal order (first quantity with CDF value at least $\beta$)?
options: $y$ is optimal, yet $y-1$ is the smallest optimum
$y$ is both optimal and the smallest optimal order
$y$ is not optimal, since $y-1$ is strictly cheaper
$y$ is the unique optimal order at that price
